postconditions.expression: all(len(s) == n for n, s in zip(input_strings['N'], input_strings['S']))
postconditions.description: Each binary string S has length N.

postconditions.expression: all(s.isdigit() and all(c in '01' for c in s) for s in input_strings['S'])
postconditions.description: Each binary string S consists only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 10**5 for n in input_strings['N'])
postconditions.description: The length of each binary string S is between 1 and 10^5.
The sum of the lengths of all binary strings S over all testcases is at most 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(output_strings[i] == max_occurrences(input_strings['S'][i]) for i in range(input_strings['T']))
postconditions.description: For each testcase, the output is the maximum number of occurrences of the substring '01' that can be obtained by performing the allowed operations.
